practical_units.clinical_and_cadaveric_landmark: Palpation of Greater and Lesser Tubercles
practical_units.dissection_plane: Superficial plane beneath anterior deltoid fibers
practical_units.maneuver: External rotation reveals lesser tubercle medially and intertubercular sulcus laterally; internal rotation places greater tubercle directly lateral.
practical_units.structures_at_risk: Anterior circumflex humeral ascending artery in groove

practical_units.dissection_plane: Deep posterior plane inferior to teres minor, superior to teres major
practical_units.maneuver: Palpate posterior aspect of surgical neck 5 cm distal to lateral acromial border to locate axillary nerve emergence with posterior circumflex humeral artery.
practical_units.structures_at_risk: Axillary nerve in humeral neck fractures or deltoid splitting incisions

practical_units.dissection_plane: Between anterior border of supraspinatus and superior border of subscapularis
practical_units.maneuver: Incise clavipectoral fascia above coracoid process to expose interval containing biceps long head tendon and coracohumeral ligament.
practical_units.structures_at_risk: Long head of biceps tendon instability if interval capsule is divided

practical_units.dissection_plane: Immediately beneath acromion and coracoacromial ligament, above rotator cuff tendons
practical_units.maneuver: Retract deltoid laterally and elevate acromion to expose glistening visceral/parietal synovial walls of the bursa.
practical_units.structures_at_risk: Bursal hypertrophy and adhesion in chronic subacromial impingement

practical_units.dissection_plane: Osteofibrous tunnel bounded by greater/lesser tubercles and transverse ligament
practical_units.maneuver: Track tendon proximally into glenohumeral joint over humeral head to its supraglenoid/superior labral origin.
practical_units.structures_at_risk: Tendon subluxation if transverse humeral ligament or subscapularis superior fibers rupture

practical_units.dissection_plane: Anterior capsule, deep to pectoralis major tendon and conjoint tendon
practical_units.maneuver: Identify medial leash of anterior circumflex vessels (three sisters) at inferior border as landmark for subscapularis tenotomy.
practical_units.structures_at_risk: Axillary nerve running along anteroinferior surface of subscapularis belly

practical_units.dissection_plane: Supraspinous fossa through subacromial space to superior facet of greater tubercle
practical_units.maneuver: Identify hypovascular zone 1 cm proximal to insertion into greater tubercle footprint.
practical_units.structures_at_risk: Degenerative tearing under compressive load of anteroinferior acromial spur

practical_units.dissection_plane: Fibrous layer spanning between crest of greater and lesser tubercles
practical_units.maneuver: Inspect continuity of fibers derived from subscapularis and supraspinatus tendon expansions.
practical_units.structures_at_risk: Tendon entrapment or medial dislocation into subscapular fossa
